summary: TEN Holdings filed an 8-K disclosing that CFO Virgilio D. Torres mutually agreed to step down effective September 30, 2026, remaining CEO, with no disagreement cited; the board concurrently appointed Ian Lawson, age 59, a Managing Director at Everest Advisors LLC, as interim CFO, principal financial and accounting officer under a consulting agreement paying Everest $4,000 monthly plus expense reimbursement, terminable on 30 days notice. The abrupt dual-role split creates a temporary finance-leadership gap; watch for a permanent CFO search, internal-control or audit-readiness disclosures, and any material weakness language in forthcoming filings.
